question: How do flying models charge?
reference: A model that can Fly can move over other models when it makes a Charge move. If it starts or ends the Charge move on a terrain feature, the distance is measured through the air rather than along the path across the battlefield. It cannot end any move on top of another model.

question: When do I determine the attacker and defender?
reference: It is done in the Determine Attacker and Defender step of setting up the battle: the players roll off, the winner is the Attacker and their opponent is the Defender.

question: What happens on a save roll?
reference: The player controlling the target rolls one D6 and modifies it by the attack's Armour Penetration. If the result is at least the model's Save the attack is saved and the sequence ends; otherwise the model suffers damage. An unmodified 1 always fails and a saving throw can never be improved by more than +1. An invulnerable save can be used instead and is not modified by AP.

question: How do units embark and disembark from transports?
reference: A unit can embark if all its models end a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 3 inches of a friendly Transport, but it cannot embark and disembark in the same phase. A unit that starts your Movement phase embarked can disembark, wholly within 3 inches of the Transport and not within Engagement Range of enemies, unless the Transport Advanced or Fell Back. If it disembarks before the Transport moves it can act normally; if after the Transport made a Normal move it cannot move further or charge that turn. A unit that disembarked cannot Remain Stationary.

question: What is the big guns never tire rule?
reference: Monster and Vehicle units can shoot, and be shot at, even while within Engagement Range of enemy units. Each ranged attack made by or against such a unit in that situation subtracts 1 from its Hit roll, unless it is made with a Pistol.

question: How do devastating wounds work?
reference: When an attack with a Devastating Wounds weapon scores a Critical Wound, it inflicts mortal wounds on the target equal to the weapon's Damage characteristic and the attack sequence ends, so no saving throw is made.

question: What does deadly demise do?
reference: When a model with Deadly Demise x is destroyed, roll one D6 before removing it. On a 6, each unit within 6 inches suffers x mortal wounds, rolling separately for each unit if x is random. A Transport rolls before any embarked models disembark.

question: How does the charge phase work?
reference: Select an eligible unit and declare a charge against enemy units within 12 inches; they need not be visible. Roll 2D6 for the Charge roll. The charge succeeds only if the unit can end within Engagement Range of every target, without entering Engagement Range of other enemies and in Unit Coherency. If so, each model moves up to the roll, ends closer to a target and must make base-to-base contact if possible; otherwise the charge fails and no models move.

question: When does a unit have to take a battle-shock test?
reference: In the Battle-shock step of your Command phase, each of your units on the battlefield that is Below Half-strength must take the test by rolling 2D6 against its best Leadership.

question: How does a unit fall back from combat?
reference: Each model can make a Fall Back move of up to its Move characteristic. It can move within Engagement Range of enemy models but cannot end there; if that is impossible the unit cannot Fall Back. A unit that Fell Back cannot shoot or declare a charge in that turn.

question: How is the wound roll calculated?
reference: Roll one D6 and compare the attack's Strength with the target's Toughness: 2+ if Strength is at least twice Toughness, 3+ if greater, 4+ if equal, 5+ if less, and 6+ if at most half. An unmodified 6 is a Critical Wound and always succeeds, an unmodified 1 always fails, and the roll can never be modified by more than 1.

question: How do I gain command points?
reference: Both players gain 1 Command point at the start of the Command phase. Outside of that, each player can only gain a total of 1CP per battle round, regardless of the source.

question: What is an aura ability?
reference: An ability tagged Aura that affects multiple models or units within a given range. A model is always within range of its own Aura. A unit can be affected by several Auras, but the same Aura applies to it only once.

question: What does cover do?
reference: A model with the Benefit of Cover adds 1 to its armour saving throw against ranged attacks, not to invulnerable saves. Models with a Save of 3+ or better cannot have it against attacks with an AP of 0, and multiple instances are not cumulative.

question: How many Space Marines units have the Infantry keyword?
reference: 157 Space Marines units have the Infantry keyword.

question: Which five factions have the most stratagems?
reference: Space Marines (279), Chaos Space Marines (105), Aeldari (100), Necrons (79) and Orks (74) have the most stratagems.

question: How does Deep Strike work, and which Necrons units have it?
reference: A unit with Deep Strike can be set up in Reserves during Declare Battle Formations, then set up in the Reinforcements step of one of your Movement phases anywhere more than 9 inches horizontally from all enemy models. The Necrons units with it are Canoptek Tomb Sentinel, Canoptek Tomb Stalker, C'tan Shard of the Deceiver, C'tan Shard of the Nightbringer, C'tan Shard of the Void Dragon, Deathmarks, Hexmark Destroyer, Monolith, Nekrosor Ammentar, Night Scythe, Obelisk, Ophydian Destroyers, Transcendent C'tan and Triarch Praetorians.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT d.name FROM datasheets d JOIN factions f ON f.Id = d.factionId JOIN datasheets_abilities da ON da.DatasheetId = d.Id JOIN abilities a ON a.Id = da.abilityId WHERE f.name = 'Necrons' AND a.name = 'Deep Strike' AND d.virtual = 'false'

question: What does the Fights First ability do, and which Aeldari units have it?
reference: Eligible units in which every model has Fights First fight in the Fights First step of the Fight phase. The Aeldari units with it are Howling Banshees, Jain Zar and Solitaire.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT d.name FROM datasheets d JOIN factions f ON f.Id = d.factionId JOIN datasheets_abilities da ON da.DatasheetId = d.Id JOIN abilities a ON a.Id = da.abilityId WHERE f.name = 'Aeldari' AND a.name = 'Fights First' AND d.virtual = 'false'

question: What does Stealth do, and which Tyranids units have it?
reference: If every model in a unit has Stealth, each ranged attack against it subtracts 1 from the Hit roll. The Tyranids units with it are Deathleaper, Lictor, Malanthrope, Neurolictor, Parasite Of Mortrex, Venomthropes and Von Ryan's Leapers.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT d.name FROM datasheets d JOIN factions f ON f.Id = d.factionId JOIN datasheets_abilities da ON da.DatasheetId = d.Id JOIN abilities a ON a.Id = da.abilityId WHERE f.name = 'Tyranids' AND a.name = 'Stealth' AND d.virtual = 'false'

question: How do invulnerable saves work, and what is the invulnerable save of a Hive Tyrant?
reference: The controlling player chooses either the model's Save or its invulnerable save for each attack, and invulnerable saves are never modified by Armour Penetration. A Hive Tyrant has a 4+ invulnerable save.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT dm.invSv FROM datasheets_models dm JOIN datasheets d ON d.Id = dm.DatasheetId WHERE d.name = 'Hive Tyrant'

question: How does a Leader attach to a unit, and which units can an Overlord lead?
reference: During Declare Battle Formations a Leader can attach to one of its Bodyguard units listed on its datasheet, forming an Attached unit treated as a single unit, and each Bodyguard unit can only have one Leader. An Overlord can lead Immortals, Lychguard and Necron Warriors.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.name FROM datasheets_leader l JOIN datasheets d ON d.Id = l.LeaderId JOIN datasheets a ON a.Id = l.attachedId WHERE d.name = 'Overlord'

question: What does the Blast ability do, and which Hive Tyrant weapons have it?
reference: Blast weapons add 1 to their number of attacks for every five models in the target unit, rounding down, and can never target a unit within Engagement Range of the attacker's army. The Hive Tyrant's Blast weapons are the Heavy venom cannon and the Stranglethorn cannon.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT w.name FROM datasheets d JOIN datasheets_wargear w ON w.DatasheetId = d.Id WHERE d.name = 'Hive Tyrant' AND lower(w.description) LIKE '%blast%'

question: What do units need to do to embark on a Transport, and what is the transport capacity of a Trukk?
reference: A unit can embark if every model ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 3 inches of a friendly Transport, and it cannot have disembarked in the same phase. A Trukk can transport 12 Orks Infantry models; each Mega Armour model takes the space of 2, and it cannot carry Jump Pack models or Ghazghkull Thraka.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT transport FROM datasheets WHERE name = 'Trukk'

question: What does Feel No Pain do, and how many Death Guard units have it?
reference: Each time a model with Feel No Pain x+ would lose a wound, roll one D6: on x or higher that wound is not lost. GOLD_COUNT Death Guard units have it.
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT d.Id) FROM datasheets d JOIN factions f ON f.Id = d.factionId JOIN datasheets_abilities da ON da.DatasheetId = d.Id JOIN abilities a ON a.Id = da.abilityId WHERE f.name = 'Death Guard' AND a.name = 'Feel No Pain' AND d.virtual = 'false'
